en: Nordic Crypto has opened the Nordic Crypto Shield to everyone. The Shield is a digital collectible badge on the Nexa blockchain in an edition of 1,000. It is free from Nordic Crypto, gives no economic rights and was designed with the EU rules for crypto-assets (MiCA) in mind.

The badge is claimed at https://nft.nordiccrypto.no/ with Wally Wallet for iPhone or Android. Users pay a small Nexa network fee themselves; the fee goes to the network, not to Nordic Crypto. When badge no. 1,000 has been minted, the right to mint more is destroyed automatically. Every mint is shown publicly with a link to the transaction, and Nordic Crypto does not store the wallet address. The service left the prototype stage on 18 October 2026.

In Norway, the Crypto-Assets Act (kryptoeiendelsloven) implements the EU regulation MiCA (Regulation (EU) 2023/1114). The act has applied since 1 July 2025. MiCA sets rules for the issuance, offer to the public and admission to trading of crypto-assets, and for services related to them. The same common rules apply in Sweden, Denmark and Finland and in the rest of the EEA. The EEA Joint Committee incorporated MiCA into the EEA Agreement by Decision No 41/2025, in force since 24 June 2025. Iceland has implemented the rules through Act No 101/2025, in force since 1 January 2026.
The Shield comes in a numbered edition of 1,000, so Nordic Crypto does not rely on MiCA's exclusion for unique, non-fungible crypto-assets.

The basis is instead how the offer is designed: the badge is free, and Nordic Crypto accepts no payment or other consideration for it, either from users or from anyone else. It is not offered to the public against payment, Nordic Crypto runs no trading platform for it, and no promise of value comes with it.
Wally Wallet is a self-custodial wallet in which users control their own keys. Nordic Crypto does not hold crypto-assets for anyone and does not exchange between crypto-assets and ordinary money.
What the Shield is, and what it is not:

ul: A digital collectible badge from Nordic Crypto, in an edition of 1,000.
In Nordic Crypto's assessment not a financial instrument, and it is not an investment offer.
It gives no economic rights, rewards or claims of any kind.
Nordic Crypto promises no value, runs no trading platform and will not buy or sell badges. The terms say the badge has no monetary value.
Transfers on the Nexa blockchain are public and permanent.

en: Finanstilsynet, the Financial Supervisory Authority of Norway, warns that crypto-assets can swing sharply in value and that consumer protection is limited. The Shield is not meant as an investment, and nothing from Nordic Crypto is investment advice.

“We wanted to make something our readers can collect, not something to speculate in. The Shield is free from us, gives no rights and promises no value. It is deliberately that simple,” says Jørgen S. Notland, founder of Nordic Crypto.

Na Noruega, a Lei de Criptoativos (kryptoeiendelsloven) implementa o regulamento europeu MiCA (Regulamento (UE) 2023/1114). A lei se aplica desde 1º de julho de 2025. O MiCA estabelece regras para a emissão, a oferta ao público e a admissão à negociação de criptoativos, bem como para os serviços relacionados. As mesmas regras comuns se aplicam na Suécia, na Dinamarca e na Finlândia e no restante do EEE. O Comitê Misto do EEE incorporou o MiCA ao Acordo EEE pela Decisão nº 41/2025, em vigor desde 24 de junho de 2025. A Islândia implementou as regras pela Lei nº 101/2025, em vigor desde 1º de janeiro de 2026.
O Shield vem em uma edição numerada de 1.000, por isso a Nordic Crypto não se apoia na exclusão do MiCA para criptoativos únicos e não fungíveis.

A base, em vez disso, é a forma como a oferta foi concebida: o emblema é gratuito, e a Nordic Crypto não aceita pagamento nem outra contrapartida por ele, nem dos usuários nem de terceiros. Ele não é oferecido ao público mediante pagamento, a Nordic Crypto não opera nenhuma plataforma de negociação para ele e não há nenhuma promessa de valor.
O Wally Wallet é uma carteira de autocustódia em que o próprio usuário controla suas chaves. A Nordic Crypto não guarda criptoativos para ninguém e não faz câmbio entre criptoativos e dinheiro comum.

MiCA mengatur penerbitan, penawaran kepada publik, dan penerimaan aset kripto untuk diperdagangkan, serta layanan yang terkait dengannya. Aturan bersama yang sama berlaku di Swedia, Denmark, dan Finlandia serta di wilayah EEA lainnya. Komite Bersama EEA memasukkan MiCA ke dalam Perjanjian EEA melalui Keputusan No. 41/2025, yang berlaku sejak 24 Juni 2025. Islandia telah menerapkan aturan tersebut melalui Undang-Undang No. 101/2025, yang berlaku sejak 1 Januari 2026.

MiCA regelt die Ausgabe, das öffentliche Angebot und die Zulassung von Kryptowerten zum Handel sowie die damit verbundenen Dienstleistungen. Dieselben gemeinsamen Regeln gelten in Schweden, Dänemark und Finnland und im übrigen EWR. Der Gemeinsame EWR-Ausschuss hat MiCA mit Beschluss Nr. 41/2025, in Kraft seit dem 24. Juni 2025, in das EWR-Abkommen übernommen. Island hat die Regeln mit dem Gesetz Nr. 101/2025 umgesetzt, das seit dem 1. Januar 2026 gilt.
Das Shield erscheint in einer nummerierten Auflage von 1.000 Stück; Nordic Crypto stützt sich daher nicht auf die MiCA-Ausnahme für einmalige, nicht fungible Kryptowerte.

Die Grundlage ist stattdessen die Gestaltung des Angebots: Das Abzeichen ist kostenlos, und Nordic Crypto nimmt dafür weder von den Nutzern noch von Dritten eine Zahlung oder andere Gegenleistung an. Es wird der Öffentlichkeit nicht gegen Bezahlung angeboten, Nordic Crypto betreibt keine Handelsplattform dafür, und es ist mit keinem Wertversprechen verbunden.

Wally Wallet ist eine selbstverwahrte Wallet, in der Nutzer ihre Schlüssel selbst kontrollieren. Nordic Crypto verwahrt für niemanden Kryptowerte und tauscht nicht zwischen Kryptowerten und gewöhnlichem Geld.

en: Nordic Crypto has launched the Nordic Crypto Explorer at https://explorer.nordiccrypto.no/. Anyone can look up blocks, transactions and addresses for Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash and Nexa in one place, in the same design as the news site. At the same time, nordiccrypto.no has grown from seven to 24 languages.
What the Explorer does:

ul: A Bitcoin front page with the latest blocks, the mempool and fee estimates. Bitcoin data comes from mempool.space and is read in the browser.
Bitcoin Cash and Nexa from Nordic Crypto's own Electrum servers.
A ranking of Nexa tokens by transfers and holders.
Amounts in NOK, SEK, DKK, EUR or USD.
Open source: https://github.com/nordic-crypto-org/nordic-explorer

The Nordic Crypto app for Apple TV can be tested through a public TestFlight invitation. The background radio, Radio Norge, now follows AirPlay speakers. An App Store version is in the works.
An update to the Android TV app, with a tab bar, its own page for the Nordic Crypto Shield and background radio with media controls, is out for testing.
